name: Aid For The Refugees

aliases: who gave aid for the refugees
quest giver aid for the refugees
faq.answer: Ealaane fled Ban'aethal with others when their settlement began to collapse. She asks travelers heading toward Shadowgale Forest to recover the belongings left in the ruins.
Ban'aethal was a settlement deep within Shadowgale Forest. Its residents fled in the middle of the night when a sudden catastrophe struck.
Ban'aethal began to fall into the sky in the middle of the night, forcing its residents to flee. The village and surrounding forest became too dangerous for them to stay or return.
faq.q: Why did the villagers have to evacuate Ban'aethal?

faq.answer: The catastrophe came suddenly in the middle of the night, leaving the villagers little time to flee with their belongings. The forest and ruins are now too dangerous, so they depend on travelers to recover what was left behind.
faq.q: Why are the villagers asking for their belongings to be retrieved?

faq.answer: Shadowgale Forest is the wooded region where Ban'aethal stood. Since the disaster tore the village apart, the forest has become extremely hazardous for ordinary folk.
No. Ealaane says Shadowgale Forest and the ruins of Ban'aethal are too dangerous for the refugees to return on their own.
faq.q: Can the refugees return to their homes?

sections.body: Ealaane and the other refugees fled their homes deep in Shadowgale Forest. With almost nothing gathered around them, they ask travelers to brave the dangers they left behind.
sections.title: A Desperate Plea

sections.body: Ban'aethal began to fall into the sky in the dead of night. Its inhabitants had only moments to escape, leaving their personal possessions behind. The surrounding woods grew hostile and dangerous.
sections.title: The Calamity of Ban'aethal

summary: After Ban'aethal fell, its survivors have little left to call their own. The settlement deep in Shadowgale Forest began to fall into the sky in the middle of the night, and danger keeps the refugees from retrieving what they left behind.
attribution: In-game quest text: Aid For The Refugees
